        s_list[i] = '@'
        mark[i + 1] = 1

for i in range(1, len(s_list) - 2):
    if ''.join(s_list[i:i+3]) == "dot":
        s_list[i] = '.'
        mark[i + 1] = 1
        mark[i + 2] = 1
